HEADING: Connected Apps
INTRO: Applications you have authorized to use the FastComments API on behalf of this account, such as AI assistants connected through the MCP server.
EMPTY_BODY: When you authorize an application, such as Claude or Cursor through the MCP server, it appears here.
REVOKE_CONFIRM: Revoke this application's access? It will have to be authorized again to reconnect.
REVOKED_FLASH: Access revoked. Tokens held by that application stop working within a minute.
UNVERIFIED_APP_NOTE: Applications register themselves when they connect.
OTHER_USERS_INTRO: Every application authorized by any user of this account. Access ends automatically when a user is removed or loses the API Admin permission, and you can revoke any of these here.
OTHER_USERS_EMPTY: No other user has connected an application.
